statements.proposition: With this change the welcome-upgrade page behaves as before for most users, with no impact on navigation or upgrade flows
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Code-level default is unchanged: the hook falls back to 'control' when the flag is unset or still loading, and 'control' renders the testimonial exactly as before. But 'most users' depends on the PostHog rollout percentage, which is not observable from the repository, and the page was also converted to a client component ('use client'), whose effect on flows was not tested. No concrete check settles the claim.
